description: Shell script for testing 'git reset' options with various scenarios. It sets up initial commits, branches, and runs multiple tests to verify that 'git reset' behaves as expected with different flags.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with a specified filename and content.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the command it runs should fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files to ensure they are identical.

methods.name: git reset
methods.description: Resets the current HEAD to a specified state, with various options.

methods.name: git add
methods.description: Stages file content for the next commit.

methods.name: git checkout-index
methods.description: Checks out files from the index to the working directory.

methods.name: git checkout
methods.description: Switches branches or restores working tree files.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
